mainEntity.name: How messy is a bathroom remodel and how do I protect the rest of the house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodels create dust, debris, noise, and frequent foot traffic through the home. To reduce disruption, ask for floor protection, dust barriers, covered vents, and a cleanup routine at the end of each workday. If you are staying home during construction, set clear access paths and keep family members away from the work zone.
